import openpyxl
from pathlib import Path

file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/53161/1_53161_input.xlsx'
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Extract agent categories (rows 4-9, columns F-N for agents Alexis, Alycia, Taylor, Edi, Brittany, Amy)
# Row 3 has headers: Agent, Category 1-9 in columns E-N
# Rows 4-9 have agent names in column E and their category assignments (1 or None) in columns F-N

agent_categories = {}
for row in range(4, 10):  # Rows 4-9 (Alexis through Amy)
    agent_name = ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value  # Column E
    if agent_name:
        categories = []

            val = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
            categories.append(1 if val == 1 else 0)
        agent_categories[agent_name] = categories

print("Agent Categories:")
for agent, cats in agent_categories.items():
    print(f"{agent}: {cats}")

# Extract agent schedules (rows 13-18, columns F-AE for time intervals)
# Row 12 has headers: Agent, then time intervals starting at column F
# Rows 13-18 have agent names in column E and their schedule (1 or None) in columns F-AE

agent_schedules = {}
for row in range(13, 19):  # Rows 13-18 (Alexis through Amy)
    agent_name = ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value  # Column E
    if agent_name:
        schedule = []
        for col in range(6, 32):  # Columns F-AE (time intervals)
            val = ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value
            schedule.append(1 if val == 1 else 0)
        agent_schedules[agent_name] = schedule

print("\nAgent Schedules:")
for agent, sched in agent_schedules.items():
    print(f"{agent}: {sched}")

# Calculate totals for each category at each time interval
# For each time interval (column), sum up the category counts for agents scheduled at that time
# Rows 22-29 are for Categories 1-8, columns F-AE are the time intervals

    for time_idx in range(num_time_intervals):  # Time intervals
        time_col = 6 + time_idx  # Columns F-AE

        total = 0
        for agent_name, schedule in agent_schedules.items():
